rv_hide_selling.help: Technical: hide selling rates for the current user on this document.

rv_hide_buying.help: Technical: hide buying rates for the current user on this document.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

is_name_manual.help: If checked, the code was entered manually and will not be auto-generated.

clearance_date.help: Customs clearance date. Used as a base for checklist deadlines when a checklist item Deadline Type is set to Clearance Date.

freight_default_bl_type.help: Default Bill of Lading type to be used when creating a new freight job.

is_paid.help: Đã thu đủ tiền của khách hàng (tất cả Debit/DC Note đã thanh toán).

is_paid_to_sale.help: Đã chi tiền hoa hồng/thưởng cho sale của job này.

has_unallocated_master_buying.help: Cảnh báo: job có ít nhất 1 house nhưng còn dòng buying trên Master B/L chưa được phân bổ xuống house nào.

is_cost_transferred.help: Đã kết chuyển giá vốn (Transfer Service Cost)

revenue_amount.help: Tổng giá trị tài khoản 511 (Credit dương, Debit âm)

has_freight_service.help: Technical: job has Sea / Air / Cross Border service.

list.arch:
<tree default_order="job_seq_no desc, id desc" js_class="job_ocr" class="freight_job_tree_view" decoration-danger="margin_local < 0">
                    <header>
                        <button name="action_close" type="object" class="ms-3" string="Close"/>
                        <button name="action_unlock" type="object" class="ms-3" string="Unlock"/>
                <button name="action_done_selling" type="object" class="ms-3" string="Done Selling"/>
                <button name="action_done_buying" type="object" class="ms-3" string="Done Buying"/>
                    </header>
                    <field name="name" string="Job Number" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="has_unallocated_master_buying" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <button name="action_open_unallocated_masters" type="object" icon="fa-exclamation-triangle text-danger fa-lg" title="Chưa phân bổ chi phí master xuống house" modifiers="{"invisible": [["has_unallocated_master_buying", "=", false]]}"/>
                    <field name="customer_mapping_ids" widget="many2many_tags" string="Customers" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="shipper_mapping_ids" widget="many2many_tags" string="Shippers" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="consignee_mapping_ids" widget="many2many_tags" string="Consignees" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="house_bl_display" widget="char_tags" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="master_code" string="Master" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="booking_no" optional="show"/>
                    <field name="container_no_display" string="Container No" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="customs_cd_numbers" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="bound" optional="hide" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="pol_display" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="pod_display" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="por_display" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="pvy_display" optional="hide" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="salesman_ids" widget="many2many_tags" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="operator_ids" widget="many2many_tags" optional="show"/>
                    <field name="transport_mode_ids" widget="many2many_tags" optional="hide" string="Services" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="load_type" optional="hide" string="Load Type (SEA)" on_change="1"/>
                    <field name="cargo_close_at" optional="show"/>
                    <field name="display_pol_etd" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="display_pod_eta" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="date" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="perf_date" optional="hide"/>
                    <field name="priority" widget="priority"/>
                    <field name="status_details" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="done_selling"/>
                <field name="done_buying"/>
                <field name="job_seq_no" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="state" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <!-- Hoàn thành từng dịch vụ (trước nằm trong state Finish Freight / Inland). -->
                    <field name="is_trucking" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="is_custom" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="has_freight_service" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="customs_status" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="freight_status" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="truck_status" string="Completed Services" widget="service_status_list" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="truck_done" optional="hide" on_change="1"/>
                    <field name="customs_done" optional="hide" on_change="1"/>
                    <field name="freight_done" optional="hide" on_change="1"/>
                    <field name="margin_local" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                </tree>

search.arch:
<search string="Job">
                <field name="name" string="Name | Inner Job" filter_domain="['|', '|', ('name','ilike',self), ('sea_inner_job', 'ilike', self), ('air_inner_job', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <field name="transport_mode_ids" widget="many2many_tags" options="{'no_open': True}"/>
                <field name="pic_id"/>
                <field name="user_id"/>
                <field name="operator_ids" widget="many2many_tags"/>
<!--                <field name="port_receipt_id"/>-->
                <field name="port_delivery_id"/>
                <field name="shipper_id"/>
                <field name="consignee_id" string="Consignee" filter_domain="['|', '|', '|', '|', '|', '|', '|', '|', ('consignee_id.name', 'ilike', self), ('consignee_id.partner_code', 'ilike', self), ('consignee_id.vat', 'ilike', self), ('air_consignee_id.name', 'ilike', self), ('air_consignee_id.partner_code', 'ilike', self), ('air_consignee_id.vat', 'ilike', self), ('truck_job_ids.consignee_id.name', 'ilike', self), ('truck_job_ids.consignee_id.partner_code', 'ilike', self), ('truck_job_ids.consignee_id.vat', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <separator/>
                <field name="house_ids" string="HBL | HAWB" filter_domain="['|', ('house_ids.name', 'ilike', self), ('truck_job_ids.truck_bl', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <field name="master_ids" string="MBL | MAWB" filter_domain="['|', ('master_ids.name', 'ilike', self), ('truck_job_ids.truck_master_bl', 'ilike', self)]"/>
                <field name="container_no_display" string="Container No"/>
                <field name="booking_no"/>
                <filter string="Air Carriage" name="air_carriage" domain="[('is_air', '=', True)]"/>
                <filter string="Ocean Carriage" name="ocean_carriage" domain="[('is_ocean', '=', True)]"/>
                <filter string="Land Carriage" name="land_carriage" domain="[('is_trucking', '=', True)]"/>
                <filter string="Customs" name="customs" domain="[('is_custom', '=', True)]"/>
                <filter string="Other" name="other" domain="[('is_other', '=', True)]"/>
                <filter string="Current Month" name="current_month" domain="[('date', '>=', (context_today() + relativedelta(day=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')), ('date', '<=', (context_today() + relativedelta(months=1, day=1, days=-1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))]"/>
                <filter name="date" string="Date" date="date"/>
                <group expand="1" string="Group By">
                    <filter string="Transport Mode" name="group_by_transport_mode_ids" context="{'group_by': 'transport_mode_ids'}"/>
                    <filter string="Customer" name="group_by_customer" context="{'group_by': 'partner_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Salesman" name="group_by_user" context="{'group_by': 'salesman_ids'}"/>
                    <filter string="Operator" name="group_by_operator" context="{'group_by': 'operator_ids'}"/>
                    <filter string="PIC" name="group_by_pic" context="{'group_by': 'pic_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="State" name="group_by_state" context="{'group_by': 'state'}"/>
                    <filter string="Bound" name="group_by_bound" context="{'group_by': 'bound'}"/>
                    <filter string="Date" name="group_by_date" context="{'group_by': 'date:day'}"/>
                </group>
                <separator/>
                <filter name="filter_truck_pending" string="Trucking: In Progress" domain="[('is_trucking', '=', True), ('truck_done', '=', False)]"/>
                <filter name="filter_truck_done" string="Trucking: Completed" domain="[('truck_done', '=', True)]"/>
                <separator/>
                <filter name="filter_customs_pending" string="Customs: In Progress" domain="[('is_custom', '=', True), ('customs_done', '=', False)]"/>
                <filter name="filter_customs_done" string="Customs: Completed" domain="[('customs_done', '=', True)]"/>
                <separator/>
                <filter name="filter_freight_pending" string="Freight: In Progress" domain="['|', '|', ('is_ocean', '=', True), ('is_air', '=', True), ('is_multi', '=', True), ('freight_done', '=', False)]"/>
                <filter name="filter_freight_done" string="Freight: Completed" domain="[('freight_done', '=', True)]"/>
            </search>
